package.name: rby1_hardware_interface
package.description: ros2_control system interface for RB-Y1 robots (A, M, UB). Exposes every rby1-sdk motion controller (joint position, joint group position, joint impedance, gravity compensation, joint/SE2 velocity, Cartesian, Cartesian impedance, impedance, optimal control) as ros2_control command modes. Requires the rby1-sdk C++ library (scripts/install_rby1_sdk.sh).
